body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## PROJECT DOCS (2026-07-26) — keep alive
- **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** (mod root): the living map — layered dependency graph, boot/lifecycle sequence, the "ONE BIG MAP" request-interception pattern, per-module reference table, cross-cutting patterns, refactor backlog. USER-OWNED; update it in the same change as any structural shift. Diagrams are Mermaid. §9 now records R1–R4 as DONE and R5 as a standing non-split.
- **`docs/generate-helicopter-view.sh`** → `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` (gitignored, ~1.9 MB, 182 files): concatenates the whole codebase into one md for whole-project chats. Regenerate before such a chat.
- **Metrics (post-refactor):** 165 C# files / ~42.5k LOC + 14 Defs/Patches XML / 1,428 LOC ≈ **43.9k LOC**. 110 declarative `Patch_*` + 24 imperative compat patches. 19 `ABGuard` kill switches. Largest files now `Logistics/CrossLevelDemand.cs` (1,489) + `Rendering/LevelRenderer.cs` (1,260) — left intact by design (R5).
- **Architecture spine:** `Levels/LevelExtensions.cs` (`map.Levels()`/`GroundMap()`/`SameColumn()`) most-depended-on; `Core/ABGuard` second; `Levels/LevelCensus` holds the tier-1 static perf gates; `Core/ABGameHooks` is the game-tick registry; `Compat/ABCompat` the compat registry.

## REFACTOR PASS R1–R4 (2026-07-26, behavior-preserving, green 0/0)
All four applied without changing runtime behavior; verified by build. Needs an in-game regression pass (see STANDING TEST QUEUE).
- **R1 — game-tick registry (`Core/ABGameHooks.cs`).** Reflection-discovered lifecycle hub. Features annotate their own static methods `[ABGameTick(order)]` / `[ABGameReset]` / `[ABGameExpose]`; `ABGameComp` runs `ABGameHooks.RunTicks/RunResets/RunExposes`. Deterministic order (by Order then type+method name), zero per-tick allocation (indexed array walk). Preserved the exact prior tick order: ritual(10)→climb(20)→supply(30)→pendingOrders(40)→hospitality(50)→neutralExit(60). 6 ticks, 7 resets, 1 expose registered — matches the old explicit `ABGameComp` list exactly. Core no longer hardcodes feature calls. **NOT genericized: LevelComp's map-scoped tick loop** (heterogeneous scheduling on the perf-critical MapComponent — deliberately stays explicit; see R3).
- **R2 — `ABDevTools` split.** 2,559-LOC monolith → `Dev/ABDevTools.cs` (setup action `EnsureLevels` + shared helpers) + 7 domain partials (`.Combat/.Movement/.Systems/.Levels/.Rendering/.Threats/.Logistics.cs`). Byte-identical method bodies (sliced), all `public static partial class ABDevTools`. 22 DebugActions preserved.
- **R3 — `LevelComp` split.** `Levels/LevelCensus.cs` (new standalone class) owns the static column-count perf gates (`AnySkyLevels`/`AnyBasementLevels`/`AnyLevelColumns` + `NoteLevel`); the per-map tick scheduler + level-sync wiring moved to `Levels/LevelComp.Scheduler.cs` (partial); `Levels/LevelComp.cs` is now the model (links, stairs registry, scribe, ctor, MapRemoved). ~30 gate call sites updated `LevelComp.Any* → LevelCensus.Any*`.
- **R4 — compat registry (`Compat/ABCompat.cs`).** Central `ABCompat.Modules` audit registry. All 27 bridge detections route through `ABCompat.Detect(id, name)` (packageId) or `ABCompat.Note(id, name, present)` (type-presence: CE, Biomes! Caverns; const-id: CAI 5000, Ancient Urban Ruins, Better Architect). `ABCompat.Setup(id, name, activate)` is the standardized boot for NEW bridges. Existing bespoke boots kept (each foreign mod needs a different probe) — R4's value was the auditable *declaration*, done for every bridge. New Dev action **"AB: list compat modules"** dumps the registry with per-target state (Absent/Present/Active/Failed).
- **R5 — DO NOT SPLIT `CrossLevelDemand`/`LevelRenderer`.** Deliberate non-action; cohesive, not churning. Revisit only if one starts taking frequent unrelated edits.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**; add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk. Build a column via "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" — **the pin gets culled at startup ("Could not find node… Removing", harmless RimWorld quirk for Playing-gated debug actions); run it from the Debug Actions menu instead**. Diagnostics: **"AB: explain haul decision"** (ToolMap), **"AB: list compat modules"** (new, R4).

## PERF — TIER-1 STATIC GATES (pass 42; gates moved to LevelCensus in R3)
Global cheap gates now live on `LevelCensus` (was `LevelComp`), keyed to the current `Game` via a `WeakReference` (a stale count from an abandoned game reads false, never wrong): `AnySkyLevels`, `AnyBasementLevels`, `AnyLevelColumns` (= sky||basement count > 0). Counts maintained by `LevelComp.FinalizeInit`/`MapRemoved` via `LevelCensus.NoteLevel(lvl, delta)`; a pocket map (level != 0) only ever exists linked to a ground, so `AnyLevelColumns` is the universal "any multi-level column exists" gate.
- **Idiom:** each hot cross-level patch's FIRST check is `if (!LevelCensus.AnyLevelColumns …) return;` (or `return true;` for skip-prefixes). The gate is a **superset** of every patch's real precondition, so it is strictly behavior-preserving — in a zero-column game (the common case) the patch bails on one static int read before touching the per-map `Levels()` CWT lookup.
- **Build B, NOT physical unpatch:** patches stay installed; we early-out. Physical `Unpatch`/re-`Patch` rejected (DrawPosOffsetPatcher patches hundreds of getters on ParallelPreDraw worker threads; re-emit poisoning risk).
- **Gated hot set (~27 entry points):** need-migration `ThinkNode_JobGiver.TryIssueJobPackage`, `JobGiver_Work`, Areas, `Map.IsPlayerHome`, `PsychicBondProximity`, `WorldObject.Tile` + storyteller wealth/pawns, `Pawn.GetGizmos`, gear/joy/learn/gatherings, mech charge/command/escort, `ColonistBar.CheckRecacheEntries`, PawnTable+Animals `Pawns`, below thing-overlays, mouseover-readout, `Targeter` hover, `SelectionDrawer.DrawSelectionBracketFor`.
- **Deliberately NOT gated (event-driven):** click/drag selection, area setter/`Notify_AreaRemoved`, trade/caravan/ritual-gather/incident-divert.

## LEVEL NAVIGATION / INPUT
Manual level switching funnels through `LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView(Map)` (preserves camera pos+zoom, selection, open Architect tool via `ABArchitectPreserve`; `ManualSwitch=true` bypasses the camera level lock). Inputs in `ABGameComp.GameComponentOnGUI` (runs BEFORE `CameraDriverOnGUI`):
- **`AB_ViewLevelUp`/`Down`** (PageUp/PageDown default), rebindable, category `AB_Keys`. VERIFIED.
- **`AB_CameraLevelLock`** (End) — toggles `LevelCamera.LevelLocked` (AUTOMATIC switches only). Gated by `cameraLockKeybind`.
- **Left CTRL + mouse wheel over the map** = move up/down. Gated by `scrollLevelKeybind` (default on). Skips over windows. **WHY CTRL NOT SHIFT:** Shift+wheel is rerouted onto the horizontal axis by OS/Unity IMGUI, zeroing the vertical wheel (killed two Shift attempts, and vanilla zoom too). Ctrl+wheel is intact. Reads `Input.mouseScrollDelta.y` (raw, +=up), frame-stamped, consumes ScrollWheel event. Verbose line: `[AB] ctrl+wheel <val> -> <target>`.

## STAIRS FLOAT MENU — single "go up/down" order (2026-07-26 fix)
Two systems both added a travel order (visible on stuffed stairs: "Go up via steel wide stairs up" + "Go up the stairs"). CANONICAL = `Building_ABStairs.BuildUseOptions` ("Go up/down the stairs" + greyed reasons). The postfix `CrossLevelOrders.AddStairsTravelOption` now yields to the base option (skips when an existing label `==` OR StartsWith `AB_GoUp`/`AB_GoDown`), so "via X" survives only as a fallback. Elevators covered. Awaiting retest.

## ART — stair/ladder/elevator texture pass (2026-07-26, MORTON)
External retexture pack (`Textures/Things/Building/AB_*`) + MORTON graphic settings grafted into `Defs/Buildings/AB_Stairs.xml` (texture settings only, gameplay preserved). 27 files, directional (+dedicated stair `_west`), single uiIcon icons. Stale `AB_Elevator_AB_Elevator.png` removed.

## PUBLISH STATE (2026-07-26)
Workshop UPDATE (PublishedFileId `3767572810`). Green 0/0. Hygiene: stubs.json empty, no pdb, no shipped 0Harmony.dll, Assemblies holds only `AsAboveSoBelow.dll`, About.xml complete (supportedVersions 1.6, Harmony dep, incompatibleWith MultiFloors/ZLevels/Strata). NOTE: the R1–R4 refactor is NOT yet published — build is green but needs an in-game regression pass first.

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX + DOCTRINE B (consumables)
**CORE:** `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs vanilla's full storage search (Harmony-patched by LWM/Adaptive Storage — modded storage honored free). `ColumnStorage.TryFindBetter` runs it on every level, crosses only for a strictly-higher tier elsewhere. **DOCTRINE B:** consumables follow one-big-map STORAGE priority into the best stockpile, fetched CROSS-LEVEL AT USE TIME. Only ACTIVE location-specific work pre-positions a stack (blueprints, live bill/surgery ingredients, refuel, transporter loads, food for an IMMOBILE consumer). MOBILE pawns register no pull. **Phase 3/4 PENDING:** event-driven upgrade driving at scale; work-migration reads ColumnStorage.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch · **PageUp/PageDown level nav**.

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000 (p39) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
- **REFACTOR R1–R4 (retest, HIGH PRIORITY):** the whole point is nothing changed. (a) R1: build a column; confirm ALL game-tick features still fire — ritual gather, climb-emerge cleanup, construct supply retry, routed-order self-heal on arrival, Hospitality guest roaming, stranded-NPC exit; new game AND after save/load (resets run in FinalizeInit; pet food-trips survive load via [ABGameExpose]). At startup with verbose logging, check `[AB] Game hooks discovered: 6 tick, 7 reset, 1 expose.` (b) R3: perf gates still work (regression = with NO column everything vanilla; with column every cross-level feature fires). (c) R4: run **"AB: list compat modules"** with a couple of the integrated mods loaded → they show Present/Active; unloaded ones Absent. (d) R2: dev self-tests still run.
- **STAIRS FLOAT MENU (retest):** RMB colonist → RMB stuffed stairwell → exactly ONE "Go up the stairs". Down stairs, ladders, elevators. Forbid → single greyed "(forbidden)"; wall off → single greyed "(no path)".
- **INPUT (ctrl+scroll):** Left Ctrl + scroll over map moves level, no zoom; plain scroll zooms; over a window scrolls the window; ends at top/bottom; toggle off in View tab; works with camera lock ON.
- **ART:** build each stairs/ladder/elevator; architect icons + ghost use new single-icon art (no magenta); south facing; rotate N/E/**W**.
- **PASS 41:** FOOD/MEDICINE + Critical stockpile 2 gaps away (forces relay) → MOVE into Critical and stay. Regressions: chunks cross; equal-tier no-cross; designation gate; downward relay no stall; PUAH no loop; bill/surgery ingredient supplied cross-level.

## Status
2026-07-26: **Refactor pass R1–R4 applied** (behavior-preserving, green 0/0) — `ABGameHooks` game-tick registry (R1), `ABDevTools` domain partials (R2), `LevelCensus` + `LevelComp.Scheduler` split (R3), `ABCompat` audit registry + "AB: list compat modules" Dev action (R4); R5 recorded as deliberate non-split. `ARCHITECTURE.md` + helicopter view updated. **Needs an in-game regression pass before publishing.** Earlier same day: authored ARCHITECTURE.md + helicopter generator; PASS 42 tier-1 static gates; double stairs float-menu fix; MORTON art pass; ctrl+scroll level nav; Workshop update 3767572810.
